about: Every result of the AO-082 film's experiments, one row per experiment and song, as the result.json files stand after audits A and B. Read with RESULTS.md (same folder).

truth.note: segment and times in seconds of songs/<S>/<S>.wav (= the cropped songs/<S>/<S>.mp4); video_offset_s = where WAV 0 s falls in the original download

fields.step: 1-10 as in EXPERIMENTS.md; 'chains' = the finished tabs (chain-1..6) of step 9's record
fields.scope: full = whole song; seg30 = the 30 s segment only
fields.status: ran | failed | refused | skipped (why says why)
fields.hint: present and true when the true tuning and capo (or tempo) were given
fields.main: the score(s) RESULTS.md quotes for this row, name: value; every score is in 'scores'
fields.show: files to draw: tabs (gp5), notes/chords/beats (csv, lab, txt), pictures, overlay video, film JSON
fields.play: files to play: renders, stems, clicks, MIDI (render.wav is on the recording's clock unless the record says otherwise: f-07 is on Guitab's own time)
fields.folder: the experiment folder: result.json, cmd.sh, score.sh and the score outputs behind every number; show/play paths without a folder are inside it
fields.floats: scores as in result.json, floats rounded to 6 significant digits (result.json holds the full value)
